mapper.sql: c.id, c.user_id, u.username, c.title, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.turn_id) FROM conversation_turn t WHERE t.conversation_id = c.id) AS turn_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_node n WHERE n.conversation_id = c.id) AS node_count, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn latest WHERE latest.conversation_id = c.id AND latest.turn_id = ( SELECT MAX(t2.turn_id) FROM conversation_turn t2 WHERE t2.conversation_id = c.id ) AND latest.type = 'assistant' ) THEN 'REASONING' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn latest WHERE latest.conversation_id = c.id AND latest.turn_id = ( SELECT MAX(t2.turn_id) FROM conversation_turn t2 WHERE t2.conversation_id = c.id ) AND latest.type = 'assistant' AND latest.error_message IS NOT NULL ) THEN 'ERROR' ELSE 'COMPLETE' END AS latest_status, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE status = 1) AS enabled_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS conversation_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_turn t JOIN conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0) AS turn_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_node n JOIN conversation c ON c.id = n.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0) AS node_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_node n JOIN conversation c ON c.id = n.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND n.type = 'GENERATE' AND n.status = 'COMPLETE') AS completed_run_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_node n JOIN conversation c ON c.id = n.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND n.type = 'GENERATE' AND n.status = 'ERROR') AS failed_run_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_turn user_turn JOIN conversation c ON c.id = user_turn.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND user_turn.type = 'user' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn assistant_turn WHERE assistant_turn.conversation_id = user_turn.conversation_id AND assistant_turn.turn_id = user_turn.turn_id AND assistant_turn.type = 'assistant' )) AS reasoning_run_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_node n JOIN conversation c ON c.id = n.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND n.type = 'TOOL_CALL' AND n.status = 'START') AS tool_call_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_node n JOIN conversation c ON c.id = n.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND n.type = 'TOOL_CALL' AND n.status = 'SUCCESS') AS tool_success_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_node n JOIN conversation c ON c.id = n.conversation_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND n.type = 'TOOL_CALL' AND n.status = 'ERROR') AS tool_error_count

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation c JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.user_id

SELECT FROM conversation c JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.user_id
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM conversation c JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{conversationId} AND c.is_deleted = 0
SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation_turn WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} UNION ALL SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation_node WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, turn_id, type, content, is_hidden, error_message, trace_id, agent_key, model_provider_key, model_name, protocol_type, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY turn_id, id

SELECT id, turn_id, trace_id, attempt_no, round_no, call_index, node_id, node_name, aggr_key, type, status, content, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_node WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY turn_id, id

SELECT starts.node_name AS tool_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(CASE WHEN terminal.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN terminal.status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count, SUM(CASE WHEN terminal.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN terminal.id IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, starts.created_at, terminal.created_at) / 1000 ELSE NULL END)) AS average_duration_ms FROM conversation_node starts JOIN conversation c ON c.id = starts.conversation_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN conversation_node terminal ON terminal.conversation_id = starts.conversation_id AND terminal.turn_id = starts.turn_id AND terminal.aggr_key = starts.aggr_key AND terminal.type = 'TOOL_CALL' AND terminal.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'ERROR') AND terminal.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest.id) FROM conversation_node latest WHERE latest.conversation_id = starts.conversation_id AND latest.turn_id = starts.turn_id AND latest.aggr_key = starts.aggr_key AND latest.type = 'TOOL_CALL' AND latest.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'ERROR') ) WHERE starts.type = 'TOOL_CALL' AND starts.status = 'START' GROUP BY starts.node_name ORDER BY call_count DESC, starts.node_name
